tasks.short: Maintain office hours for student advice and assistance

steps.what: During actual office-hour enquiries, retrieve and check the relevant course requirements, assessment guidance or student record
inputs: Existing course guidance and authorized student record

steps.what: Maintain the scheduled office hours, hear students' concerns and personally advise and assist them
outputs: Advice and assistance during office hours

tasks.design: Use existing course and student-linked views in {LMS} and the student registry {OPS_SYSTEM} to retrieve facts during real enquiries. The teacher retains scheduled availability and personal assistance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Looking up current course requirements and authorized student information can interrupt advice.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing filtered course and student views can reduce repeated navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding the student's difficulty and deciding how to help.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher responds to the student's actual circumstances and reasoning.

ambition.what: Reduce actual enquiry lookup effort within office hours.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; course and registry owners confirm advisory access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: LMS and student-registry views can retrieve course and authorized student facts for an enquiry.

assumptions: Course and registry owners supply existing records; s1 checks currency and resolves gaps manually. No model advice or free new data capture is assumed.
No repeated calendar setup, appointment notice or extra office-hour report is invented; schedule setup once per term is not charged to every meeting.
This live-assistance episode has no established required record or send. Actual written advice is modeled separately in task 6204 and counted once if the same enquiry.
Illustrative gross saving 6 per 100 task hours, upkeep 1, net 5; scheduled availability and live assistance remain fully counted.
unknowns: Actual lookup effort during office hours and existing direct links
research_questions: Which recurring student enquiries still require navigating several course or registry screens?

already_counted.description: Check actual course and student facts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured office-hour enquiry scenario; only actual fact lookup reduced after upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise on curricula and criminal justice careers

steps.what: Hear the student's academic interests, progress, vocational goals and constraints
Retrieve and check current academic and vocational curriculum requirements and supplied career-service information relevant to the student
inputs: Institution's actual current curriculum and career-service references
outputs: Checked options, requirements and unresolved questions

steps.what: Judge suitable academic and vocational options and formulate the actual advice and its limitations for this student
outputs: Teacher-authored advice points and source references

steps.what: Draft, edit and check the actual written advice reply against the teacher's advice points, sources and intended recipient

loop.purpose: Express the teacher's actual advice clearly in a written reply
loop.input: Teacher-authored advice points and checked source extracts
loop.output: Draft reply preserving the teacher's options and limitations
loop.check: Teacher checks every recommendation, requirement, source and recipient before completing s4
loop.stop: Missing source or new unsupported recommendation returns to teacher; no send
loop.why_not_simpler: Individual explanatory wording needs semantic drafting; fixed requirement text is reused verbatim first

steps.what: Send the final checked advice reply to the intended student through institutional email
inputs: Final checked advice reply and recipient

tasks.design: Retrieve actual curriculum and careers references from {LMS} and {DOCS}, then draft the teacher's already formulated advice into an {EMAIL} reply. The teacher checks the final reply before a separate send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reference lookup and expressing individualized advice in writing can repeat work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reference indexes and bounded prose drafting can assist without choosing the student's career.
tasks.still_hard: Judging realistic options and explaining uncertain career paths.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher weighs the student's aspirations and circumstances against actual requirements.

ambition.what: Reduce source lookup and actual written-advice drafting effort.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; institution approves advisory sources and student-data handling

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: indexed institutional references and bounded language-model drafting can assist a teacher-authored written advice reply.

assumptions: This episode is an actual written student-advice reply, not an extra follow-up after every conversation. Purely verbal advice must be measured separately.

The teacher captures student needs and authors advice points in s1 and s3; curriculum and career-service owners supply current references. Missing or uncertain requirements remain unresolved rather than inferred.
No current career vacancy, legal qualification rule or named opportunity is invented; use the institution's actual supplied information.
Illustrative gross saving 14.7 per 100 task hours, upkeep 2.5, net 12.2. Same-email send earns no click saving, and shared enquiry work with 6205 is counted once.
unknowns: Actual written-versus-verbal advice mix and institutional draft-tool availability
research_questions: Which current written advice replies repeat source searches and explanatory drafting?

already_counted.description: Check source information, formulate advice and edit and check the final reply

incremental.description: Maintain advisory references and review draft quality

approvals.approved_version: Final advice reply and student recipient checked in s4; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured actual written-advice episode; source lookup and prose drafting reduced after upkeep, teacher judgment retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on teaching and research issues

steps.what: Retrieve and check the existing course or research working material relevant to the actual issue raised by colleagues
inputs: Existing course or research working documents

steps.what: Collaborate with colleagues to examine the teaching or research issue, challenge alternatives and agree changes
Make and check the agreed changes in the actual shared teaching plan, reusing existing course fields and approved blocks
Save the final checked working-plan revision in the same shared document

tasks.design: Use existing course-linked views and reusable blocks in {DOCS} and {LMS}. In this teaching-plan issue, colleagues agree the substantive change and the teacher updates and checks the actual working plan before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Retrieving the relevant working version and repeating existing course fields can add handling effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Shared document links and reusable structured fields can reduce that handling.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving substantive differences and judging implications for teaching or research.
tasks.human_edge: Colleagues bring disciplinary knowledge and responsibility for their shared decisions.

ambition.what: Reduce document handling in an actual collaborative teaching-plan revision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: shared document systems can link current working versions and reuse existing structured course fields.

assumptions: This episode already includes changing a shared teaching plan; no new minutes or post-meeting report is invented.
Colleagues supply the actual issue and source documents, and s3 captures the real agreed changes. Research-only conversations without a working-plan revision need a separate effort split.
The saved document remains a working revision, not a course publication or research submission; any later release needs the actual release authority and gate.
Illustrative gross saving 9.8 per 100 task hours, upkeep 2, net 7.8; same-document save earns no gain.
unknowns: Actual issue mix and current shared-document reuse
research_questions: Which current teaching-plan fields are copied manually during collaborative revisions?

already_counted.description: Check the issue context and make and check actual agreed document changes

incremental.description: Maintain working-version links and reusable course fields

approvals.approved_version: Final working-plan revision checked in s3; changes require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured actual teaching-plan revision scenario; only retrieval and repeated fields reduced after upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in recruitment, registration and placement

steps.what: Participate in actual recruitment conversations, explain the criminal justice program and hear prospective students' questions
inputs: Actual prospective students and program information
outputs: Informed student interests and actual questions

steps.what: Collect and verify actual registration details, student preferences and required evidence in the existing registration form
outputs: Checked registration inputs with student identifiers and preferences

steps.what: Match the checked registration inputs to existing prerequisite, capacity and placement-availability records using approved exact rules
outputs: Draft rule-match results and exceptions, without admission or placement decisions

steps.what: Discuss actual registration exceptions and placement options with the student and responsible coordinator and establish the actual authorized outcome
outputs: Actual agreed outcome within existing authority or unresolved case

steps.what: Enter the actual authorized registration outcome and placement preference and check all final record fields against student evidence and coordinator agreement
inputs: Original student evidence and checked rule sources
outputs: Final checked registration and placement-preference record

steps.what: Save the final checked record in the same student-registration system
inputs: Final checked registration and placement-preference record

tasks.design: Configure exact prerequisite and availability matching in the existing student-registration {OPS_SYSTEM}. The teacher retains recruitment conversations, actual evidence capture, exception discussions and final record checks; the rule output is a draft rather than an admission or placement decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated manual comparisons between registration details and current prerequisite or capacity records can duplicate work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing registration forms and rule tables can produce explicit matches and exceptions.
tasks.still_hard: Individual exceptions, student suitability, placement agreement and actual decision authority.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher and responsible coordinator interpret the student's situation and establish the authorized outcome.

ambition.what: Reduce exact-rule comparisons while retaining personal recruitment and placement coordination.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4; registry and placement owners approve access, rules and delegated record-entry authority

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: registration systems can compare supplied student details with explicit prerequisite and capacity rules and surface exceptions.

assumptions: This episode includes actual recruitment participation and delegated registration recording, not automatic admissions. The responsible coordinator supplies current placement availability and actual outcome authority.
Student evidence is collected and checked in s2; registry owners supply approved rules. Missing evidence or stale availability stops the affected match for manual handling.

No external placement offer, agreement, notification or automatic allocation is proposed. Formal placement execution remains with the actual responsible process and must be measured if this role performs it.
Illustrative gross saving 15 per 100 task hours, upkeep 2, net 13; existing rule checks already automated earn no new gain and the same-system save has none.
unknowns: Actual teacher registration authority and current rule automation
research_questions: Which prerequisite and capacity comparisons are performed manually by teachers today?

already_counted.description: Capture evidence, resolve actual exceptions and enter and check the authorized final record

incremental.description: Maintain prerequisite and availability mappings with registry and placement owners

approvals.approved_version: Final authorized record checked in s5; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured delegated-registration episode with manual exact-rule matching today; capture, judgment and checks retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Coordinate current curriculum, registry and placement information with their actual owners.
skills_to_grow: Respect actual admission and placement authority
role.ambitious_version: A criminal justice teacher who spends less time finding requirements and repeating exact record checks while retaining student advice, colleague collaboration and recruitment judgment.

job.title: Criminal Justice and Law Enforcement Teachers, Postsecondary
